summary: Silicon Motion Technology (NasdaqGS: SIMO), a Hong Kong-incorporated NAND flash controller maker reporting as a foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on October 8, 2026 whose sole exhibit is a press release scheduling its third quarter 2026 earnings conference call. Results will be released after market close on October 28, 2026, with a call on October 29 at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time requiring advance registration; no transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. This is a routine earnings-calendar notice, not a special situation. Watch only for quarterly guidance and demand commentary.
